description.value: 101 Canada Boba is a Vancouver-founded bubble tea chain launched in 2020, serving grab-and-go fruit teas, milk teas, and seasonal specialty drinks made with premium ingredients—70% sourced directly from Taiwan. The Main Street location is one of six BC stores built around a streamlined quick-service model, making it a fast hydration stop for cyclists passing through the neighbourhood. The brand operates a loyalty rewards program with over 80% customer return rate.
